scope: Independent flat scene3d object add/copy/remove; no hierarchy/assets/World/backend or independent save transaction.
recommendedGuards: New optional objects ABI and exact action/receipt shape; old parse/transform ABI remain additive and separately available.
Only source snapshot/path/SHA/owner/in-memory apply mechanics are shared; transforms and objects keep separate private proposal brands.
Readonly preview retains only its existing three-field source snapshot and never receives an applyDraft closure.
Action, displayed source object, fresh UUID and reviewed proposal must agree with captured private intent, including silent DOM changes before Check.
Fresh UUID assigned once on begin or legitimate target change, not regenerated by Check, language refresh, Apply or retry.
Copy reuses complete original raw object span; only instanceId/name value tokens may change. Same semantic name retains original escaped spelling.
Remove requires at least one surviving object and preserves surviving source order/identity/token spelling; test first, middle and last across nonadjacent separators/whitespace.
Validate original and complete final scene, unique UUIDs, 128 object cap, 128 KiB UTF-8, and exact candidate bytes/net paths before any draft mutation.
Host guards same-path document reload, raw content, load/draft epoch, base/current revisions and external form ownership around every await.
Receipt must bind exact approved action/target/path/content/new token; wrong kind, stale or forged result cannot confirm.
Preserve disk baseline/version/cache and ordinary Save/external conflict handling; no implicit write, execute or save.
independentProbePlan: All three real native edits plus copied-byte fidelity and raw CLI/WASM receipts.
Collision, last-object removal, 128 count/final-growth budgets and invalid full-scene atomic rejection.
Wrong action/old and new target identity/net paths/candidate whole-content receipt rejection.
Original-source descriptor guards, digest ownership drift and serialized/wrong-domain brand rejection.
Silent Action/Object/NewIdentity/raw Name/Color before and after review, late close/source/reload and bad new-token receipt.
Old transform/read-only/native APIs and author data remain protected after shared host extraction.
limits: Recommendations do not certify not-yet-built implementation.
No fixed Node, native test/build, browser, external backend, installation, staging, commit or push was invoked.
Only this new evidence directory is writable; previous reports and author files remain immutable.
